meta.name: 2177 The San Francisco Love Hacker Crimes
meta.description: A man wakes up after an attempt on his life, with no memory of who he is. He suddenly finds himself on the run with his would-be assassin. His wife, a hard-edged, cool-headed police officer, begins a desperate search to find him. A move that could end her career.
meta.slogan: Lost between a cop and a killer, you can't prepare for where love will take you.
